name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This balances visibility for keyboard users with subtlety to avoid cluttering the interface. The glow improves contrast on busy backgrounds without overwhelming the design. Trade-off: it’s slightly less prominent than a 3-pixel ring, but that’s intentional to keep the focus indicator clean and consistent with our brand’s minimalist style.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less prominent." A 1px ring + 1px glow at 30% opacity keeps focus visible without obscuring content at any zoom. Test it at 125% zoom with a high-contrast theme; if it passes, adopt it.
